title: Concept: Health check exposes dependency status
description: A health document that reports database status in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The document tells an attacker which dependencies exist and which one is currently down, which is the timing signal a denial-of-service probe needs.
applicability: Deployments that render a health document that reports database status into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The document tells an attacker which dependencies exist and which one is currently down, which is the timing signal a denial-of-service probe needs.
